description: Deprecated: use kb_research. Search saved items in the KnowMan Inbox, Knowledge Base, or Archive without returning content bodies; a location filter costs one extra lookup per hit. Every result carries `trust`: 'internal' is the user's OWN knowledge (their pages, documents and designated links) and outranks 'external' saved articles on anything about the user themselves. Returns snippets only; kb_get_item reads the full text.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

location.description: Optional Inbox, Knowledge Base, or Archive location filter.

query.description: Text to search for in KnowMan.

scope.description: Which knowledge to search: 'internal' (the user's own pages, documents and designated links), 'external' (articles they saved), or 'all'. Defaults to all.

name: kb_search
title: Search your knowledge base
